name: linnya
description: An agent-centered document database and extensible desktop workspace.

scripts.test:provider-adapter-package-gate: pnpm --dir packages/linnkit-provider-ai-sdk run typecheck && pnpm --dir packages/linnkit-provider-ai-sdk run test && pnpm --dir packages/linnkit-provider-ai-sdk run pack-smoke

scripts.start:electron: wait-on dist/main/main.cjs dist/main/preload.js dist/main/measurement-worker.js dist/main/measurement-preload.js packages/plugins/slides/dist/raster-worker/worker.html packages/plugins/slides/dist/backend/raster-worker-preload.cjs packages/plugins/slides/dist/brush-worker/worker.html packages/plugins/slides/dist/backend/brush-worker-preload.cjs packages/plugins/slides/dist/backend/presentation-build-worker.cjs dist/main/worker.html dist/ingestion.worker.cjs dist/audio-processing.worker.cjs dist/graph-extraction.worker.cjs dist/graph-indexing.worker.cjs dist/main/app-server-entry.cjs dist/main/app-server-backend.cjs dist/main/sandbox/sandboxUtilityProcess.cjs dist/main/sandbox/sandboxEvaluatorProcess.cjs dist/main/commands/commandRunnerProcess.cjs dist/main/commands/commandRunnerUtilityProcess.cjs node_modules/@app/schemas/dist/index.js && pnpm run guard:better:electron && cross-env NODE_ENV=development LINNYA_DEV_MODE=true APP_VERSION=${npm_package_version} electron dist/main/main.cjs

scripts.build:electron: cross-env LINNYA_BUILD_TARGET_PLATFORM=win32 LINNYA_BUILD_TARGET_ARCH=x64 pnpm run build:electron:prepare && pnpm run prepare:windows-app-local-runtime && cross-env LINNYA_WINDOWS_COMMAND_RUNTIME_BUILD_TRUST=development npm_config_msvs_settings_cflags="-IC:/msys64/mingw64/include/cairo -IC:/msys64/mingw64/include/pango-1.0 -IC:/msys64/mingw64/include/glib-2.0 -IC:/msys64/mingw64/lib/glib-2.0/include -IC:/msys64/mingw64/include" npm_config_msvs_settings_ldflags="-LC:/msys64/mingw64/lib" electron-builder --projectDir dist_build --win
